topic: store a guitar to prevent humidity damage
core_question: How do I store my guitar so humidity doesn't warp it?
answer_summary: Store the guitar in its case with a soundhole or case humidifier to maintain roughly 45-55% relative humidity, avoiding attics, cars, or spots with big temperature swings.
